mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leetcode_submission_record ( student_id, problem_id, code, language, accepted, score, ai_feedback, passed_cases, total_cases, confidence, recommendation_request_id, recommendation_session_id, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{problemId}, #{code}, #{language}, #{accepted}, #{score}, #{aiFeedback}, #{passedCases}, #{totalCases}, #{confidence}, #{recommendationRequestId}, #{recommendationSessionId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSubmissions, SUM(CASE WHEN accepted = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN accepted = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrongCount, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS avgScore FROM leetcode_submission_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT lsr.id, lsr.student_id, lsr.problem_id, lsr.accepted, lsr.score, lsr.ai_feedback, lsr.passed_cases, lsr.total_cases, lsr.confidence, lsr.submitted_at, lsr.created_at, lpb.title_main AS problem_title, lpb.difficulty AS problem_difficulty, lpb.source_url AS problem_source_url FROM leetcode_submission_record lsr LEFT JOIN leetcode_problem_bank lpb ON lpb.id = lsr.problem_id WHERE lsr.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY lsr.submitted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
